sections.changelog:
Changed

  • **The categories filter offers the level the shopper is actually choosing.** A term's count already includes everything filed beneath it, so a parent listed beside its children repeated them: on a parts catalogue the panel opened with "Запчасти 971", "Дисплей 501" and "Сенсорный экран 469" — the same products under three headings — and the values that narrow anything were pushed down the list or off it. Every value that has a descendant in the same list is now dropped, leaving the deepest categories the query reached; a parent whose children the query never touched keeps its place, since for this result set it is a leaf. Measured on a 13k-product catalogue, "дисплей" went from three top rows covering the whole result to ten values that each cut it down (iPhone 91, Fly 69, Huawei 57 …), panel built in 44 ms. Each value now carries its parent underneath it, the way the live dropdown already does — without it the two "Fly" branches (69 under touchscreens, 36 under displays) were indistinguishable. More values are fetched than shown so the dropped ancestors do not shorten the list.
